evidence.reason: The finding targets `../docs/...` links in .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, claiming they break when GitHub copies the template into a PR description. At the current tip the template contains no `../docs/...` links: the only repository reference is line 20's `docs/promotion-policy.md`, and the CodeRabbit-cycle section the finding also flagged (line 50) has been removed. History shows commit f922d466 ('fix(review): use root-relative link for merge policy in PR template') rewrote the merge-policy link, and f31cb29 removed the remaining mandatory cycle guidance. The specific relative `../docs/...` references alleged in the finding are no longer present, so the described defect has been addressed by those changes rather than persisting at the tip.
